validity_findings.detail: Auth state vs drift/noise conditions are orthogonal by design: Phase A uses /api/data probe, Phase B pairs /api/session/status (behavioral) with /api/schema (structural) per sample but endpoints are isolated (drift does not affect /api/schema content beyond noise_type; noise does not affect /api/session/status).
